@isTest private class CoreRuntimeMessagingInboundEmailDTOEvidenceTest { @isTest static void rows() { Messaging.InboundEmail.AuthenticationResultField authField = new Messaging.InboundEmail.AuthenticationResultField(); authField.name = 'smtp.mailfrom'; authField.value = 'example.com'; Messaging.InboundEmail.AuthenticationResult auth = new Messaging.InboundEmail.AuthenticationResult(); auth.method = 'spf'; auth.result = 'pass'; auth.authenticationResultFields = new List{authField}; Messaging.InboundEmail.Header header = new Messaging.InboundEmail.Header(); header.name = 'Content-Type'; header.value = 'text/plain'; Messaging.InboundEmail.BinaryAttachment binary = new Messaging.InboundEmail.BinaryAttachment(); binary.body = Blob.valueOf('trail'); binary.fileName = 'trail.bin'; binary.headers = new List{header}; binary.mimeTypeSubType = 'application/octet-stream'; Messaging.InboundEmail.TextAttachment text = new Messaging.InboundEmail.TextAttachment(); text.body = 'trail text'; text.bodyIsTruncated = false; text.charset = 'UTF-8'; text.fileName = 'trail.txt'; text.headers = new List{header}; text.mimeTypeSubType = 'text/plain'; Messaging.InboundEmail email = new Messaging.InboundEmail(); email.authenticationResults = new List{auth}; email.binaryAttachments = new List{binary}; email.ccAddresses = new List{'cc@example.test'}; email.fromAddress = 'sender@example.test'; email.fromName = 'Sender'; email.headers = new List{header}; email.htmlBody = '

trail

'; email.htmlBodyIsTruncated = false; email.inReplyTo = 'reply-1'; email.messageId = 'message-1'; email.plainTextBody = 'trail text'; email.plainTextBodyIsTruncated = false; email.references = new List{'reference-1'}; email.replyTo = 'reply@example.test'; email.subject = 'Trail'; email.textAttachments = new List{text}; email.toAddresses = new List{'to@example.test'}; Messaging.InboundEmail clonedEmail = (Messaging.InboundEmail)email.clone(); System.assertNotEquals(email, clonedEmail); System.assertEquals('Content-Type', header.name); System.assertEquals('text/plain', header.value); System.assertEquals('spf', email.authenticationResults[0].method); System.assertEquals('trail.bin', email.binaryAttachments[0].fileName); System.assertEquals('cc@example.test', email.ccAddresses[0]); System.assertEquals('sender@example.test', email.fromAddress); System.assertEquals('Sender', email.fromName); System.assertEquals(1, email.headers.size()); System.assertEquals('

trail

', email.htmlBody); System.assertEquals(false, email.htmlBodyIsTruncated); System.assertEquals('reply-1', email.inReplyTo); System.assertEquals('message-1', email.messageId); System.assertEquals('trail text', email.plainTextBody); System.assertEquals(false, email.plainTextBodyIsTruncated); System.assertEquals('reference-1', email.references[0]); System.assertEquals('reply@example.test', email.replyTo); System.assertEquals('Trail', email.subject); System.assertEquals('trail.txt', email.textAttachments[0].fileName); System.assertEquals('to@example.test', email.toAddresses[0]); System.assertEquals('Trail', clonedEmail.subject); System.assertEquals('pass', auth.result); System.assertEquals('smtp.mailfrom', auth.authenticationResultFields[0].name); System.assertEquals('trail text', text.body); } }
